channel.title: Skyline Map blog
channel.description: Guides to mapping your Cities: Skylines city: exporting with CSLMapView, finding your files, transit maps, directions, tolls and fares, and what an export contains.

item.title: How to turn your Cities: Skylines city into an interactive map
item.description: Export your Cities: Skylines city with the CSLMapView mod and open it as a detailed, interactive map in your browser, on Windows, Mac or Linux. Step by step.

item.title: Where CSLMapView saves your .cslmap files (Windows, macOS, Linux)
item.description: The folder CSLMapView exports to on Windows, macOS and Linux, how the files are named, and the fastest way to open that folder from a file picker.

item.title: Make a metro-style transit map of your Cities: Skylines city
item.description: Generate a schematic transit map of your Cities: Skylines metro, train, tram, ferry and bus lines automatically, in the style of the London and Seoul maps, from a CSLMapView export.

item.title: Driving, transit, walking and cycling directions in your Cities: Skylines city
item.description: Plan Google Maps-style driving, public transit, walking and cycling routes on your own Cities: Skylines road and transit network, from a CSLMapView export. How it works and what it can't know.

item.title: Toll roads and transit fares for your Cities: Skylines city
item.description: Find the toll booths in your Cities: Skylines city, see which routes pay tolls, avoid them, and set your own toll fees, transit fares, transfer rules and currency.

item.title: What a CSLMapView export contains, and what it doesn't
item.description: A plain guide to the data in a Cities: Skylines CSLMapView .cslmap file: roads, lanes, buildings, transit, terrain and districts, plus what is missing and how Skyline Map fills the gaps.
